system.description:
Replace «Pruification Barrier» with this skill at CR11 or higher. The target gains [Barrier: (Magic Power x 2) + (Recovery)].

(Fate 1): Increase the rating of the [Barrier] by +[POW base].

Magic that creates a mirror-like barrier around allies to protect them from enemy attacks. A blessing that embodies your determination to protect your allies grows in strength according to your willpower.
